baseline_models.focus_anchor: ثَبَّتْنَاكَ / كِدتَّ تَرْكَنُ إِلَيْهِمْ / شَيْئًا قَلِيلًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Active divine strengthening interrupts a near movement from becoming settled reliance on a human side; the object-plus-smallness phrase measures an incipient but unrealized shift.

activation_trace.role: Making something firm and strong supplies the active counterforce that prevents the near movement from settling.
Approach to an act marks the leaning as genuinely near yet still incomplete.
A strong side used for support makes the possible lean a relocation of reliance, not merely passing sympathy.
Inclination followed by repose supplies both the directional motion toward them and the threatened settled endpoint.
A knowable and reportable thing makes the possible concession objectifiable rather than wholly vague.
Smallness bounds the degree of the approached concession without erasing its reality.

changed_reading.before: The ayah simply says that no leaning occurred.
changed_reading.after: The ayah discloses a real near-threshold: a small, objectifiable shift of reliance was approached but did not settle because divine stabilization intervened.

baseline_models.mechanism: The split inventory lets grammatical near-action coexist with an echo of strenuous handling and stratagem, so the threshold can be carried as pressure-produced rather than as an unprompted preference.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary approach to an act preserves the primary syntax of an unrealized near-action.
Strenuous processing supplies an exploratory pressure-field around the approached act.
Stratagem and manipulation supply a possible external mechanism producing the threshold.
Strengthening supplies the interrupt that keeps pressure from becoming settled inclination.
Inclination and repose identify the pressured movement's intended result.

changed_reading.before: The addressee simply almost chose to lean.
changed_reading.after: The near leaning can also be carried as a threshold induced by strenuous manipulation; this remains an exploratory echo beside the primary near-action sense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus becomes the hinge between two attempted removals: first from revealed content, then from the land. Their repeated near-actions generate the addressee's near-response, while stabilization interrupts the displacement before it settles.

activation_trace.role: Active strengthening supplies the intervention at the center of the mirrored attempts.
Approach without completion makes the focus the near-response between their two near-actions.
Inclination toward a side supplies the inner displacement that corresponds to the surrounding outer pressures.
Their approached act opens the first half of the repeated near-action frame.
Turning someone away from truth supplies the first displacement, away from what was revealed.
Their second approached act closes the repeated near-action frame after the focus.
A light force that shakes stability supplies the physicalized attempt to dislodge the addressee.
Passage to the outside supplies the intended territorial endpoint of the second displacement.

structural_cues: 17:73 and 17:76 repeat وَإِن كَادُوا around 17:74 لَقَدْ كِدتَّ, aligning their near-actions with the addressee's near-response.
17:73 targets departure from revealed content, whereas 17:76 targets removal from the land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored near-action grammar, diversion, destabilization, and expulsion; I infer one displacement sequence with inner leaning as its hinge. A live alternative keeps doctrinal and territorial pressure parallel but causally distinct.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports an isolated moment of possible sympathy.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the central hinge of a coordinated displacement sequence: they nearly move the addressee from revelation and place, and he nearly begins the corresponding inward move before being stabilized.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier campaign manufactures agitation, participation, and deceptive promise but lacks governing authority; the sufficient preserving agent is the Lord. Against that contrast, leaning toward them would mistake a mobilized pressure network for a dependable side.

activation_trace.role: A strong side relied upon supplies the focus question of where dependable support is located.
Divine strengthening supplies the effective support that the surrounding campaign only counterfeits.
Lightness that shakes stability supplies the campaign's initiating jolt.
Participation supplies the attempt to penetrate ordinary relations as a network of shared claims.
Deceptive glitter that does not hold supplies the false appearance of a dependable side.
Power and authority supply the governing capacity that the source construction explicitly negates.
One who manages sufficiently and preserves supplies the true locus of dependence.

structural_cues: 17:64 accumulates voice, mounted and foot forces, participation, and promise before naming deception.
17:65 negates authority over عِبَادِى and immediately declares the Lord sufficient as وَكِيلًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies agitation, partnership, deceptive appearance, negated authority, and sufficient agency; I infer a counterfeit support system competing with the focus's ركن. The alternative is that 17:64-65 describes general adversarial reach without directly specifying the antecedent pressure in 17:74.

changed_reading.before: Leaning toward them is mainly an emotional or political concession.
changed_reading.after: Leaning toward them would begin to treat a noisy but authority-less network as a reliable support, while the actual preserving agency is already identified elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence links directional deflection, replacement of revealed content, and intimate affiliation. A slight lean is therefore the first movement in an exchange where altered speech yields social acceptance.

activation_trace.role: Inclination and repose supply the initial movement toward the proposed affiliative endpoint.
A knowable concession supplies the exchange with a determinate, if small, object.
Turning away from truth supplies the intended directional deflection.
Divine disclosure identifies the content from which the pressure seeks movement.
Fabricated falsehood supplies the proposed replacement speech.
Substitution supplies the explicit operation of exchanging the revealed object for another.
Affection permeating the self supplies the promised social endpoint of the substitution.

structural_cues: In 17:73, لِتَفْتَرِىَ states the intended content change and وَإِذًا لَاتَّخَذُوكَ خَلِيلًا states the consequent affiliation immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deflection, revelation, fabrication, replacement, and friendship; I infer that acceptance functions as leverage for content substitution. The live alternative is that friendship is only a consequence, not an inducement consciously offered.

changed_reading.before: The possible lean is an unspecified softening toward them.
changed_reading.after: The possible lean is the first increment of a content-for-affiliation exchange: alter what is conveyed, then be absorbed as an intimate ally.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated measure of littleness moves from the adversary's claimed exception, through the focus's near concession, to the opponents' short aftermath. The focus quantity becomes a hinge in a reversal of who is actually bounded.

activation_trace.role: Smallness supplies the bounded degree at the center of the repeated sequence.
Smallness first bounds the exception left outside the adversary's projected reach.
Smallness finally bounds the opponents' duration after the attempted expulsion.

structural_cues: The exact ق ل ل occurrence appears as إِلَّا قَلِيلًا in 17:62, as شَيْئًا قَلِيلًا in 17:74, and as إِلَّا قَلِيلًا in 17:76.
The ordered recurrence moves from the adversary's boast, through the focus threshold, to the would-be expellers' curtailed stay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the three ordered smallness measures; I infer a deliberate scalar reversal that relocates boundedness from the threatened faithful remainder to the pressure and its agents. The alternative is that the three quantifiers are locally independent.

changed_reading.before: قَلِيلًا only minimizes the degree of leaning.
changed_reading.after: قَلِيلًا also participates in a boundedness reversal: adversarial reach appears vast, the possible concession is held to a slight threshold, and the agents' own aftermath is made slight.

context_deltas.mechanism: A written and exactly placed account that does not omit even a minute fiber is followed by doubled consequence. This converts the focus's little something from a dismissible trace into a minimally legible and consequential deviation.

activation_trace.role: A knowable and reportable thing makes the possible deviation legible to accounting.
Smallness supplies the minimum quantity whose significance is being tested.
Binding inscription that establishes judgment makes even a small act recordable.
Putting a thing outside its proper place supplies the miscalibration that exact judgment excludes.
The minute fiber furnishes the local benchmark for smallness that is not negligible.
Addition of an equal amount supplies the consequence-amplification immediately following the condition.

structural_cues: 17:71 denies injustice even by فَتِيلًا before the focus.
17:75 follows the focus condition with parallel ضِعْفَ clauses for life and death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a minute benchmark, binding record, exact placement, and doubled consequence; I infer a juridical scale around شَيْئًا قَلِيلًا. The alternative is that 17:71's accounting and 17:75's conditional consequence remain separate without defining the focus quantity.

changed_reading.before: A little leaning sounds too slight to matter.
changed_reading.after: The little something is a minimum detectable concession: precisely bounded, fully legible, and serious enough to enter an amplified consequence structure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The personal act of stabilization is placed beside a continuously followed way that cannot be shifted. The local prevention of leaning thus participates in a larger invariant order rather than appearing as an improvised rescue.

activation_trace.role: Continuance against removal supplies the personal-scale fixity enacted in the focus.
A continuously followed way supplies the historical-scale order within which the stabilization operates.
Change from one state to another supplies the operation explicitly denied of that governing way.

structural_cues: 17:77 follows the attempted removal in 17:76 and closes with وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّتِنَا تَحْوِيلًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies personal stabilization followed by an untransformable historical way; I infer that the former locally enacts the latter. The alternative is that 17:77 governs only the expellers' fate and does not characterize the stabilization itself.

changed_reading.before: ثَبَّتْنَاكَ is a one-time rescue from a momentary lapse.
changed_reading.after: ثَبَّتْنَاكَ is also a local enactment of an invariant order that pressure can test but cannot transfer into another course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates tremor and instability branches behind adjectival قَلِيلًا, whose primary force remains scalar. It stays anchored through the direct contrast with ثَبَّتْنَاكَ and the repeated context branch that names a light force shaking stability; downstream prose should present it only as a branch-driven kinetic image.

activation_trace.role: Continuance and fixity supply the stable state against which a minute wobble is perceived.
A small tremor supplies a bodily image for the slightest onset of concession.
Instability and movement supply the micro-wobble that stabilization arrests.
Lightness that shakes stability supplies the earlier external impulse for the wobble.
The repeated destabilizing lightness confirms the kinetic pressure on both sides of the focus.

changed_reading.before: قَلِيلًا is only a scalar adverb meaning a small degree.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the small degree is also imaged as a barely perceptible wobble induced by external shaking and arrested by stabilization.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-default carrying branch of ق ل ل against adjectival قَلِيلًا. It remains anchored by the load-bearing ركن image and 17:70's explicit carrying branch; downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy, never as a replacement lexical gloss.

activation_trace.role: A load-bearing side supplies the support surface toward which reliance could shift.
Lifting and bearing supplies the exploratory image of transferring a small share of load.
Bearing a visible load supplies the contextual carrier from which the imagined support transfer departs.

changed_reading.before: The ayah describes a slight degree of interpersonal leaning.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, it describes almost transferring even a small share of one's load from the carrier already named in context to another purported support.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it imports the surrounding maritime mechanics into inner stabilization. It remains valid as an analogy through gentle propulsion, oscillating waves, rescue, and the focus's support-and-inclination language; downstream prose should not claim that the focus lexically denotes a vessel or voyage.

activation_trace.role: Active strengthening supplies course correction rather than mere immobility.
Inclining and settling toward a side supplies the shift of balance that must be corrected.
Gentle propulsion supplies a model of guidance that preserves movement while controlling direction.
Oscillating waves supply the unstable medium in which steadiness must be dynamically maintained.
Release by separation supplies the contextual rescue that restores a threatened trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Divine stabilization means holding the addressee rigidly in place.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, stabilization is dynamic course-keeping: maintaining rightward movement through pressure without allowing balance to settle toward the wrong side.

strongest_changes: The mirrored كَادُوا / كِدتَّ / كَادُوا sequence makes 17:74 the hinge between attempted displacement from revelation and attempted displacement from the land.
The support branch of ر ك ن, read against negated adversarial authority and sufficient divine agency, changes leaning into a threatened relocation of reliance.
The recurring ق ل ل measures and the nearby minute-accounting benchmark make شَيْئًا قَلِيلًا bounded and consequential rather than dismissible.
The immediate deflection-replacement-friendship chain makes slight leaning the first increment of a content-for-affiliation exchange.
summary.what_was_special: The packet activated one mechanism at several scales: inner inclination, social recruitment, textual substitution, territorial removal, and invariant order. Split-root material added a contained pressure-and-stratagem echo to كِدتَّ, while the non-default tremor and carrying branches of ق ل ل yielded inspectable kinetic and load-bearing outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The friendship in 17:73 may be leverage offered for substitution or only its projected consequence.
The maritime, micro-wobble, and load-transfer readings are branch-grounded analogies, but their cross-domain direction remains reader-supplied.
The non-dominant ك ي د mapping may legitimately color the pressure field without altering the primary ك و د near-action syntax.
